title: Hurricane Florence Damage Assessment
description: U.S. Marine Corps Col. Russel C. Burton, the Marine Corps Air Station New River commanding officer, assesses the damage on MCAS New River, N.C., Sept. 15, 2018. Hurricane Florence has impacted Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune and MCAS New River with periods of strong winds, heavy rains, flooding of urban and low lying areas, potential flash floods and coastal storm surges. (U.S. Marine Corps Video by Staff Sgt. Albert J. Carls)

transcript.text: I remember the last time I came down here, but none of this was done.
This is where the river came. Look at this.
Hey Marines, it's 915 on Saturday the 15th of September.
I'm doing this shot to show you why I'm telling you not to come back to New River right now.
Behind me you see the New River.
I am standing on the patio of the officers club,
and you can see that the winds are coming from downstream pushing the river up.
It's going to continue to rain. The waters continue to rise.
So wait until we tell you to come back before you come back to the river.
